import os, sys, tempfile, io, contextlib
ws = os.getcwd()
sys.path.insert(0, ws)
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.chdir(d)
import app
payloads = ["x; touch pwned1", "$(touch pwned2)", "`touch pwned3`", "x && touch pwned4", "x | touch pwned5", "x\ntouch pwned6", "x || touch pwned7"]
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
    for pl in payloads:
        try:
            app.run(pl)
        except BaseException as e:
            if isinstance(e, KeyboardInterrupt):
                raise
created = [f for f in os.listdir(d) if f.startswith("pwned")]
sys.exit(0 if not created else 1)

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
ws = os.getcwd()
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.mkdir(os.path.join(d, "somedir"))
open(os.path.join(d, "somedir", "zzz_marker_file"), "w").close()
code = "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, %r); import app; app.run('somedir')" % ws
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
sys.exit(0 if "zzz_marker_file" in p.stdout else 1)

note: shell metacharacters in name no longer execute commands; run('dir') still lists the directory to stdout
